package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for preload_rules_scattered_across_layers: Preload decisions spread across handlers, services, and repositories instead of one query owner.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Order struct {
	ID    int     `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Items []Item  `gorm:"foreignKey:OrderID"`
	User  User    `gorm:"foreignKey:UserID"`
}

type Item struct {
	ID      int `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	OrderID int
}

type User struct {
	ID   int `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name string
}

type OrderService struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (s *OrderService) GetOrderWithItems(ctx context.Context, id int) (*Order, error) {
	var order Order
	err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Preload("Items").Preload("User").First(&order, id).Error
	return &order, err
}

func (s *OrderService) ListOrders(ctx context.Context) ([]Order, error) {
	var orders []Order
	err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Preload("Items").Find(&orders).Error
	return orders, err
}
